snippet.title: Welcome To Mars 9 // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/2434330/Welcome_To_Mars_9

You wake up in a luxurious space station orbiting Mars with no memory of your past. Explore, solve puzzles, and make ethical choices in this narrative adventure with multiple endings.

👥 Players: Single-player
🛠️ Developer: Sonomio Games
📚 Publisher: Sonomio Games
📅 Release Date: Sep 16, 2026
🎯 Genre: Adventure, Indie

The developers describe the content like this:
There's a bar with alcoholic drinks.
The game's gameplay forces the player to take some ethical decisions and shows some kind of non explicit violence.
One character is naked but no explicit parts of the character are shown (the character is covered).
